title: credential.switched v1
description: Work moves to another credential (the subject): a handoff, the end of a credential hold, or a fresh lease on a credential other than the one last recorded.

from_credential_id.description: The credential last recorded for the work, or null.

model.description: The model actually used on the new credential; null when none is set.

review_id.description: The review the run was doing, or null.

job_id.description: The job the run was doing, or null.
